title: Algorithmic Software Engineer
intro: I'm Hans, a software engineer in Odense who likes problems where milliseconds and megabytes matter. At TriVision I was the lead developer on Production Intelligence V4, a platform that ingests 420M+ machine vision inspections a year, and cut its dashboard load times from 10s to 0.1s and its storage costs by 92%. I got by improving arhitectural patterns, and by picking data structures and storage formats that make sense for the workload.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Lead developer on Production Intelligence V4, a platform that ingests 420M+ machine vision inspections a year. Cut dashboard load times from 10s to 0.1s with server-side rendering and caching, which meant finding where the latency actually lived before touching code. Owned the backend end to end: data structures, SQL schema, deployment on AWS, and releases to factory customers.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Designed the ETL pipeline behind Production Intelligence V4 and benchmarked columnar storage formats against the naive ones. That evaluation later cut storage costs by 92%. Learned to settle engineering arguments with measurements

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Built a Python pipeline that renders synthetic images to train two deep learning models for object detection and 6DoF pose estimation. It combines data cleaning, structuring, and statistical modeling. Released as the open source project BlenderBin at github.com/hansaskov/BlenderBin, and used by others to improve the state of the art in bin picking.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Collected and analyzed data from distributed IoT devices and built a real-time dashboard so the team could monitor their products and prioritize on numbers.

roles.title: MSc in Software Engineering
roles.description: Specialized in distributed systems and backend engineering, with electives in cybersecurity and biometric security, where I learned to think in threats and to handle sensitive data the way legislation demands.

roles.title: BEng in Robotic Systems
roles.description: Found my love for software, statistics, and mathematics through control theory, computer vision, and machine learning. Programmed a UR5 robot arm to detect, grasp, and throw objects with collision-aware motion planning. My first experience with algorithms where efficiency is not optional.
